answer_1.quote: ...collect a dataset of human judgements over a diverse set of model generated summaries on the CNN/DM and XSum datasets... we evaluate different summarization models... the paper focuses on summarization as an NLG task...

answer_2.quote: ...We select four general summarization metrics. ROUGE, BLEU, and Meteor are n-gram based metrics... We select five metrics focused on factuality. ... OpenIE baseline, FactCC, DAE, FEQA, QAGS...

answer_4.quote: ...We collect human annotations from three independent annotators... We conduct the annotation task on the Amazon Mechanical Turk (MTurk) platform... annotators first select whether the sentence is factual, and if not, identify the category of each error...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators label each sentence as factual or non‑factual and, for non‑factual sentences, select one or more error categories from the proposed typology (PredE, EntE, CircE, CorefE, LinkE, OutE, GramE, OthE, NE).
criteria: error type classification (PredE, EntE, CircE, CorefE, LinkE, OutE, GramE, OthE, NE)
